purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian beverage/distribution company Promax ERP system - Comodato (loan equipment) collection closure processing (Fechamento de Recolhas de Comodatos), including CDD (Centro de Distribuição Direta) operations, RF (radio frequency) integration, and WMS integration
purpose.summary: This program handles the closing of comodato (loaned equipment/materials) collection orders in the Promax ERP system. It processes return notes, manages controlled materials with serial numbers, handles multi-CDD units, and integrates with WMS and radio frequency systems. It also supports reversal of closed collections for CDD operations.
